```{r date_setup}
start_date <- ymd("2017-12-01")
end_date   <- ymd("2025-12-31")
```

```{r load fred}
getSymbols(c("DCOILWTICO", "SP500"), src = "FRED", auto.assign = TRUE)

us_daily <- merge(DCOILWTICO, SP500)
us_daily <- us_daily[paste0(start_date, "/", end_date)]

df_us_daily <- tibble(
  date     = as.Date(index(us_daily)),
  wti_oil  = as.numeric(us_daily$DCOILWTICO),
  sp500    = as.numeric(us_daily$SP500)
)
```
```{r load lseg-ph-finmkt}
ph_10y_raw <- read_excel("PH_10Y_GS_YIELD_1825.xlsx", skip = 18)
ph_10y_daily <- ph_10y_raw %>%
  select(date = Date, ph_10y_yield = `Yield to Maturity`) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    ph_10y_yield = as.numeric(ph_10y_yield)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))

psei_raw <- read_excel("PSEI_1825.xlsx", skip = 32)
psei_daily <- psei_raw %>%
  select(date = `Exchange Date`, psei_close = Close) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    psei_close = as.numeric(psei_close)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))

usdphp_raw <- read_excel("USDPHP_1825.xlsx", skip = 28)
usdphp_daily <- usdphp_raw %>%
  select(date = `Exchange Date`, usdphp_mid = `Mid Price`) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    usdphp_mid = as.numeric(usdphp_mid)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))
```

```{r load lseg-ph-macroecon}
read_ph_macro <- function(filepath, var_name) {
  read_excel(filepath, skip = 1) %>%
    set_names(c("date", var_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(date) & !is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      # Truncate to first of the month for clean relational joins
      year_month = floor_date(date, unit = "month"),
      !!var_name := as.numeric(.data[[var_name]])
    ) %>%
    select(year_month, all_of(var_name))
}

cpi_monthly  <- read_ph_macro("PH_CPI_YY_1626.xlsx", "ph_cpi_yy")
m3_monthly   <- read_ph_macro("PH_M3_YY_1626.xlsx", "ph_m3_yy")
mfg_monthly  <- read_ph_macro("PH_Manufacturing_Production_YY_1626.xlsx", "ph_mfg_prod_yy")
```

```{r consolidate main-dataframe}
daily_financials <- psei_daily %>%
  full_join(usdphp_daily, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(ph_10y_daily, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(df_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  # forward fill missing based on last previous day
  tidyr::fill(psei_close, usdphp_mid, ph_10y_yield, wti_oil, sp500, .direction = "down")

financial_monthly <- daily_financials %>%
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, unit = "month")) %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
```


```{r consolidate main-dataframe}
summarise(
    psei_close   = last(na.omit(psei_close)),
    usdphp_mid   = last(na.omit(usdphp_mid)),
    ph_10y_yield = last(na.omit(ph_10y_yield)),
    wti_oil      = last(na.omit(wti_oil)),
    sp500        = last(na.omit(sp500)),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

df_econometrics <- financial_monthly %>%
  left_join(cpi_monthly, by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(m3_monthly,  by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(mfg_monthly, by = "year_month") %>%
  filter(
    year_month >= floor_date(start_date, "month") &
    year_month <= floor_date(end_date, "month")
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_month)

glimpse(df_econometrics)
head(df_econometrics)
```
